lines.text: Welcome to Router 7, the busiest junction in the data center.
It's 5 PM, rush hour. Packets are flooding in from every direction.
Hey rookie! I'm Alex, your mentor. Ready for your first shift?
Your job is simple: classify packets using DSCP codes so the network knows how to prioritize them.
Get it right, and data flows smoothly. Get it wrong... well, let's not find out.
Here comes your first packet. Let's see what you've got!
